# P03 repair checkpoint

Recovered all nine contributed files, including checker, nine test methods,
conformance.json and result.md. Prior process timed out; prior PASS is not accepted
without fresh execution. The earlier progress note was stale.

Skeptical audit: retain borrowing.acc and independent typed inputs as comparators;
require semantic rejection, input sensitivity and complete catalog execution.
Arithmetic and schema success remain engineering diagnostics. No changes to the
approved scope, dependencies or defaults. Missing cases, failed invariants or
protected-input changes prevent acceptance and trigger focused repair.

Current protected inputs captured in /tmp/accdsl-p03-repair-entry.json. Prior
phase-entry comparison remains available. Next checks: run required unittest suite,
inspect semantic validation and checker, repair exposed failures, regenerate both
outputs and update this checkpoint with exact results. No new implementation yet.

Meaningful edits: core0_ir_v1.py now rejects omitted assumptions/report mappings
and disconnected model/scope/scenario semantics; tests and the case catalog include
ten additional schema-valid regressions. check_accounting_p03.py checks duplicate
obligations, failed observation records and hashes against the repair-entry
snapshot. The profile records these findings. The first fresh required suite
passed nine methods in 2.394 seconds; after the first repairs it passed in 2.492
seconds. Next: execute final suite and checker, inspect generated results, confirm
protected files, and replace this checkpoint with final evidence.
